title: Optimize set operation ORDER BY limit sorting
description: Avoid fully sorting all set operation outer ORDER BY rows when a finite LIMIT/OFFSET window is requested.
convergence_criteria: Set operation ORDER BY parses LIMIT/OFFSET before sorting; finite LIMIT uses select_nth_unstable_by; SQL set operation tests pass
hints: Keep original row index as tie-breaker in partial selection to preserve stable ordering.
execution_directives: cargo fmt --check; cargo check --lib; cargo test --test sql_integration test_union -- --nocapture; cargo test --test sql_integration test_except -- --nocapture; cargo test --test sql_integration test_intersect -- --nocapture
findings: Added limit-window top-k ordering for set operation outer ORDER BY and SQL coverage for UNION ALL ORDER BY LIMIT OFFSET.
